title: Q-ULTRA-country-snapshot-claims_drift-UNMEASURED: essential variable country-snapshot:claims_drift cannot be read
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** `country-snapshot:claims_drift` has no fresh reading (source tenant.claims_drift)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status
**Status:** open

An unmeasured variable is never in bounds and never a reason to change the system. Make the reading (probe, writer or fresh ledger row) so the loop can judge it.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status` shows `country-snapshot:claims_drift` with a value.
